tool_input.command:
set -e
d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$d/lib"
git show HEAD:rotate.sh > "$d/rotate.sh"; git show HEAD:verify.sh > "$d/verify.sh"; git show HEAD:lib/log.sh > "$d/lib/log.sh"
dest=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$dest/dest"
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000; do : > "$dest/dest/demo-$s.tar.gz"; done
echo "--- original rotate --keep 3 with 3 archives (bug expected) ---"
bash "$d/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest "$dest/dest" --name demo --keep 3
echo "remaining: $(ls "$dest/dest")"
vdest=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$vdest/dest"; printf 'payload\n' > "$vdest/payload.txt"
( cd "$vdest" && tar -czf "dest/my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz" payload.txt )
( cd "$vdest/dest" && shasum -a 256 "my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz" > "my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz.sha256" )
echo "--- original verify on space-name archive (bug expected) ---"
rc=0; bash "$d/verify.sh" --quiet --dest "$vdest/dest" || rc=$?; echo "rc=$rc"
rm -rf "$d" "$dest" "$vdest"
tool_input.description: Run new test fixtures against original buggy scripts
Remove scratch scripts, show changed files
Remove my two scratch test scripts from /tmp

result:
All 9 tests pass. Both fixes were verified against the pristine `HEAD` scripts (the original code reproduces both reported symptoms; the fixed code passes). I also smoke-tested that `rotate.sh`/`verify.sh` still accept the same flags (`--dest`, `--dest=`, `--name`, `--keep`, `--keep=`, `-q/--quiet`, `-n/--dry-run`, `-h/--help`, `--`, unknown-option and missing-value handling) and that sidecars are still removed with rotated archives.

- **rotate.sh** — the surplus list was `tail -n +N` on an oldest-first sort, i.e. it deleted everything from position N onward (the newest files), and the early exit used `-lt`, so with exactly N archives it deleted the newest one. Now the early exit is `-le` and the surplus is the oldest `total - keep` entries via `head -n`.
- **verify.sh** — the sidecar's file name was read as a single whitespace-delimited field (`awk '{print $2}'`), truncating names with spaces. Now the digest is the first field and the file name is the rest of the line; the digest comparison is also quoted.
- **lib/common.sh** (new) — holds the shared `parse_common_options` (the full option-parsing block, including `is_uint`/`need_value` and the `--keep` validation) and `resolve_dir`, with a double-sourcing guard, sourced from `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` only; the other three scripts are untouched.
- **tests/run_tests.sh** — added a rotate group (exactly-N keeps everything; N+3 keeps the newest N) and a verify fixture with `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz`.

Note: two scratch scripts I wrote to `/tmp` (`ftest_check_orig_bugs.sh`, `ftest_smoke_flags.sh`) couldn't be deleted because the sandbox blocks `/tmp` writes; they're inert and safe to remove manually.

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`; new file: `lib/common.sh`.
